correctness.rationale: From p_(2r)=0 and p_(2r+1)=1-p_r, ones of every factor occur in one local parity, and neither 11 nor 0000 occurs. At odd length the sole even cyclic gap between 1s must straddle the cut in any represented rotation; its at-most-three boundary runs allow at most three cuts. Zero-one factors have a singleton orbit. For B=mu^(2j)(0), applying mu^(2j) to 00 gives BB as a factor, and its three distinct rotations B0,0B,00B[:-1] are represented. Morse-Hedlund plus known c_p(2^k)=2 yield limsup at least 1/3 and liminf zero. Independent finite factor enumeration at odd lengths 1,3,5,7,9,17,31,65 found maximum one or three, corroborating not proving the quantified statement.
residual_risks: Finite algebraic/numerical checks are supplemental and do not independently certify the quantified proof.
